title: PlayAnimation
description: animation (since 1.5): she chose an animation to play now (her play_animation function). The node plays it once, on top of what she is doing (waiting, talking), and goes back to that when it is over. A node that does not know the animation ignores the frame.

name.description: Its name, for a node that shows what she does.

loop.description: True plays it until she does something else; false or null plays it once.
